title: A section vanishing on an open containing the weakly associated points vanishes
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a quasi-coherent F on X with WeakAss(F) contained in an open U, the restriction map Gamma(X, F) -> Gamma(U, F) is injective (source lines 651-658). The proof takes a section s vanishing on U, forms the image F' of the map O_X -> F defined by s, shows that Supp(F') is disjoint from U, uses that WeakAss(F') is contained both in WeakAss(F) and in Supp(F') to conclude WeakAss(F') is empty, and then applies the lemma saying a quasi-coherent module with empty weakly associated locus is zero.
